name: ResolveMoveFlags
meaning: ScnObject::Collide_ResolveMove's flags argument (0x50e6b7), on top of the CollideClass bits of the contacts to slide along (flags & COLL_WALL, then flags & COLL_FLOOR; 0 sweeps once and never slides). Read from its code (src/engine/scenaric.cpp): the sweep query is CQ_STATIC | CQ_OBJECTS plus what these bits change, never the argument itself (verified)

name: RESOLVE_SLIDE_ALL
meaning: COLL_FLOOR | COLL_WALL | COLL_FLOOR_EDGE, the usual mask (Wolf steps, Gossamer, Catapult, WoodenLift): slide along floors and walls (the slide never tests the COLL_FLOOR_EDGE bit: floor edges are stepped onto or block) (verified)

name: RESOLVE_KEEP_Y
meaning: sliding keeps the vertical part of the displacement: only x and z are projected off the contact planes (verified)

name: RESOLVE_ASK_MOVER
meaning: the sweeps add CQ_ASK_MOVER (0x10) and CQ_IGNORE_SKIPBOX (0x20) (verified)

name: RESOLVE_NO_STATIC
meaning: the sweeps drop CQ_STATIC (no static triangles) and add CQ_IGNORE_SKIPBOX (0x20) (verified)
